title: SQL AG status: primary + sync secondaries
description: The nexus-cli status verb for the Always On AG: the FCI primary + the two async standalone replicas and their sync state.

observe.what: sqlfci = primary; sql-ag-rep-1/2 = secondary syncing; leader = sqlfci

whatProves: the AG nexus-ag has the FCI as primary and two standalone replicas as secondaries; status reads sys.availability_replicas + the hadr replica-state DMVs from the primary.
